entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Hey, did you see that tablet earlier?[n]Whoever drew that picture was a[n]real pro.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Not as good as Inari though. He's got[n]a particularly pervy view on art.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Wh-Whoa, what's going on!?

entries.speaker: Skinny Man
entries.en: There's a super-limited sale at the PC[n]section!

entries.speaker: Black-Haired Woman
entries.en: Three terabytes for only five hundred[n]yen!? What a steal!

entries.speaker: Jogging Man
entries.en: That's gonna sell out in seconds!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Mayday, mayday... I'm trapped in the[n]Home Appliance Kingdom... The Three[n]Terabyte War rages on outside...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: There are just... so many people...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Hrgh... I don't know if I can last[n]much longer...
The call cut out...
Maybe I should go look for Futaba...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: There you are!
I what?
So you're okay?
I was about to come find you.[clr 27]

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I-I found you...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I'm not okay at all! I'm like... NO-kay![n]I was super scared!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: O-Oh... Thanks.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I didn't think I was gonna see you until[n]the end of time...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: But then I thought about you while I was[n]wandering around the store, and bam,[n]a wild [fName] appeared!
Good to see you again.[clr 27]
You're the one who appeared.
You need to be more careful.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: So you're relieved? What an incredible[n]coincidence! Me too.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Did you summon me?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: It was an accident...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I'll try and be more careful next time[n]though...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Wait a tick, I just finished a promise![n]"Go somewhere with lots of people"!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Well, am I awesome or what!?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: It's all 'cause of the Three Terabyte War[n]though! Oh, and 'cause you brought me[n]here!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I, Futaba Sakura, hereby thank thee!
I can sense Futaba's[n]innocent joy...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I dunno though... I panicked hard when[n]I was soloing that dungeon...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I think... not being with you is kinda[n]scary, [fName].

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: All right then, I'm gonna add another[n]goal to my list: "Being okay without[n]you around."

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: It might be a long questline, but I'll finish[n]it someday!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: ...Phew, I'm tired.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: C'mon, let's go home!
